page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number left and running title with chapter reference right; running text in one column below; a side heading "Caput" at right below the text. Right margin edge shows fragments of text from the neighbouring page (not transcribed).

main_text.p: um. multo satius est omni carnis esui in æternum renuntiare (quanto magis ab immolatis abstinere) quàm ventris replendi & voluptatis explendæ causa, fratri lapsus & æterni exitij inde promanantis occasionem præbere: atque ita meipsum Christi in quem hæc injuria redundat, horrendæ iræ obnoxium facere.
main_text.head: Caput

page.notes: The text begins with the fragment "um." continuing from the previous page. The "Caput" heading is set in italic at right and is a chapter opening. Some ink spots and marks on the page are not text. Marginal fragments at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted.
